title: Entitlement Sensitivity Scoring + Approval Orchestration for Enterprise Admin Requests
creator: Maya Chen
description: Deliver a lightweight, auditable scoring system and approval orchestration that classifies incoming admin & access management requests (RBAC role changes, SSO/SAML enablement, SCIM provisioning adjustments, org policy overrides). The scorer should combine request attributes (requester role, target scope, requested privilege delta, data sensitivity, compliance tags) into a prioritized queue and trigger the correct approval path (self-approve, delegated approver, security review, legal review). The goal is to reduce manual triage time for Platform/Support, enforce consistent guarantees for enterprise customers, and enable measurable SLAs and routing for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring model defined and documented: weight table for attributes + example scoring for 10 common request types
Approval flows implemented as policy templates in Console: self-approve, team-approver, security-review, legal-review
Triage UI shows top-10 pending requests with score, ETA to decision, and suggested approver
Automated Slack notifications and email digests for queued approvals with actionable links
Audit log entries created for each score decision and approval action (link to audit schema)
E2E tests and a small pilot with two enterprise customers completed and feedback captured

implementation_notes: Keep initial scorer deterministic and transparent; store weight table in Console config so PM/Support can adjust without deploys.
Approval templates should be versioned and included in the customer export for compliance audits.
Integrate with existing SSO/SAML change workflows: SSO enable/disable must surface dependency checks (SCIM mapping impact).
Plan to surface cost/latency impact only for Dedicated/Private customers when role change affects resource quotas.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-blocking common low-risk requests -> Mitigation: exempt list + pilot + telemetry on false blocks
Risk: Approval fatigue for large orgs -> Mitigation: allow delegated approver pools and auto-approve heuristics for low-score items
Risk: Audit gaps -> Mitigation: require immutable audit entries before any state change; expose export for compliance
